chunks: (Jesus) was only a creature whom We favoured and made an example for the children of Israel.

key_terms.أَنْعَمْنَا: We favored or bestowed grace upon

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Jesus being a servant rather than God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal in refuting the divinity of Jesus (Isa) by affirming his status as a created servant (abd) whom God favored, thereby establishing him as a clear exemplar (mathal) for the Children of Israel. This highlights the theological principle that prophets are human messengers chosen by God, not divine entities, serving as a model for guidance rather than objects of worship.
